text:
Jordan: Hey all — planning the RFC review sync for Thu 3/26 10:00am PT. Want to slot 4 authors (12min presentation + 8min Q each). Please claim slots or note constraints. Pre-reads should be in the RFC doc (short TL;DR + risks) by Tue EOD so reviewers can prep. Notion link: https://notion.so/rfc-review-board

Jordan: Slot template (copy and paste):
```
Slot N — Author: <name> — RFC link: <url> — Time preference: <morning/late>
```

AlexC: I can take slot 2 — presenting the feature-x infra changes. Added RFC link.

Maya: I can review slots 1 and 3. Also I have a flight at 11am — would prefer to present earlier if I'm an author.

Samir: What's total meeting length? Just making sure calendar has enough buffer.

Jordan: Total 80min including 4x(12+8) and 2x5min buffer. Calendar invite set for 90min to be safe.

Maya: @Jordan if you need to reorder, I can present first.

Jordan: Great — we'll put Maya first then AlexC, Samir if needed. Still need one more author.

AlexC: Quick pre-read ask: authors please include a 1-paragraph rollout plan + one bullet of failure modes in the doc. Saves time during review.

Samir: Roger. Also do we want slides or demo?

Jordan: Slides ok (1–2), demo only if it's quick. Keep Q focused.

calendar-bot: Created event "RFC review — 3/26" and invited #eng reviewers.

Maya: Added my pre-read summary and risks. 

AlexC: Pre-read uploaded.

Samir: I'll claim slot 4 for the data-pipeline RFC. Putting RFC link in the doc now.

Jordan: Awesome. Final checklist: authors add TL;DR+risks+rollout by Tue EOD, reviewers add comments on Notion if possible, show up 5min early. If you need a slot swap, ping here. :thumbsup:

AlexC: Got it, thanks.

Maya: Thanks — see you Thu. :rocket:

Samir: :thumbsup:
